statements.status_notes: PingFederate processes JSON input using Jackson’s synchronous streaming parser (JsonFactory.createParser) and ObjectMapper APIs, both of which enforce StreamReadConstraints. The non-blocking parser path affected by GHSA-72hv-8253-57qq is not used anywhere in the codebase. Additionally, request bodies are wrapped with length-limiting input streams, providing further protection against large payload-based DoS conditions.

PingAccess does not appear to be vulnerable to GHSA-72hv-8253-57qq. We don’t call any of the async jackson-core parsing classes within our application. Additionally an attacker would first have to gain access to an administrative account to upload any json for parsing.

PingAuthorize does not utilise the vulnerable "NonBlockingUtf8JsonParserBase" class, hence it is not vulnerable. However, the Jackson library will be upgraded in version 11.1 (June 2026) of the product to prevent the issue from appearing in future scans.
